description: Answer 'is this deployed workflow healthy, and is it still what we deployed?' in one call. `stats`: run counts, error rates and p50/p95 durations per node type from the workflow's own telemetry. `health`: Cloudflare's independent count of invocations, errors and CPU time, which also catches failures the telemetry cannot see. `drift`: whether the deployed script still exists in the user's Cloudflare account (catching one deleted by hand) and, with GitHub sync, how far the mirror is behind; plan-gated. Each section answers on its own: one that cannot be read carries an `error` and is listed in `warnings`, and the rest still return. Read each section's `caveats` before concluding. For raw log lines use get_deployment_logs.

include.description: Sections to read. Default all three; fewer is faster.

since.description: Time window for stats and health. Default 24h.

workflowId.description: The workflow's id, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: get_deployment_status
title: Get deployment status
